conciseReport:
Automobile HTTP Browsing / Ping / Video Streaming: 15 criteria attempted; 2 Passed, 3 Failed, 2 Unverified, 8 Blocked.

Observed failures: HTTP legend double-click did not isolate sibling items (3); HTTP boundary ordering was accepted without an error and Video Streaming exact category 1 could be saved as 1.5 (11); narrow dual-map legends overlapped and intercepted layer controls (14).

Blocked branches need an identified multi-field consuming fixture, independent versioned legend/default definitions and existing-consumer regression baselines. Active-layer/data isolation and linked Network-context/category reconciliation remain Unverified. No excluded consumer was used as an acceptance substitute. All acceptance images are fresh and criterion-owned; discarded Download/setup/unsettled images are excluded.

Browser: observed Google Chrome 156.0.8078.48. No synthetic responses were used. Test-created layers were removed, editor drafts closed, and single-map 1440x900 layout restored. Exact original camera restoration after zooming was not independently proven. Pre-existing saved workspace state varied across launcher loads and was re-established for each criterion; no unrelated layer/detail was deliberately changed.
reason: Performed all canonical criteria with fresh scoped evidence. Required multi-field fixtures and independent versioned baselines remain missing; observed product failures and incomplete comparisons are recorded separately.
